description: React component implementing a frontend view for a finalized personality profile in a career navigator application. It fetches data from backend APIs, handles local storage fallback, and renders persona details such as name, role, summary, competencies, and career highlights.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-empty object.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out non-string entries.

methods.name: coerceCareerHighlights
methods.description: Transforms various input formats into an array of CareerHighlightItem objects.

methods.name: extractFinalPersonaFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts the final persona data from an orchestration record object.
